behavior.settings: Admin/dealer Settings adds 내 재고금융 이율. Rates are personal per(company,user); company lender names, borrowing limits and legacy default rates remain separate.
behavior.fallback: Blank removes personal override and uses source-company server-confirmed default; explicit0 is a real override. Rates support0..100% with at most4 fractional decimal places.
behavior.ownership: Use vehicle-owner profile across details, registration, totals, sale/date snapshots and server income settlement. Known foreign/missing/ambiguous profiles never use viewer personal terms.
behavior.sharing: Only accepted uniquely-owned shared vehicles authorize source-owner terms, filtered to actual shared lender names. Admin/accountant same-company reads retain former-owner terms while vehicles remain.
behavior.history: Finalized sold snapshots remain authoritative. No vehicle or shared finance payload was bulk-rewritten.
behavior.lifecycle: Captured auth/company/client/role/epoch and own-only revisionCAS; profile read runs alongside dataset restore before initial financialrender, with late-response and retry handling.
behavior.catalog: Confirmed own source lender names populate vehicle inputs; lender-save ACK and company-purchase load refresh rates without changing active money drafts.
behavior.viewToggle: One borderless vehicle button shows currentmode icon and switches between list/cards. Existing storage key, table/card layouts, sorting, search and pagination remain; customer toggle unchanged.

validation.browserServices: Actual application/index/API code, synthetic upstream auth/RPC and scoped CAS; no live credentials.

database.publicRpcSecurity: Security invoker wrappers, authenticated execute only; anon and service_role execute denied. Private definer functions derive verified active unique membership.

advisors.security: New INFO rls_enabled_no_policy is intentional deny-all on private table, with no direct table grants and guarded RPC-only access.

limitations: Hosted authenticated preference writes were not exercised with real accounts; database authorization/CAS was tested using the actual migration in isolated Postgres and production schema/ACL metadata was verified.
